properties.description:
Slice 2. A radius that reaches a mirrored node says which design that node belongs to (its rows carry the design), and names the members to continue in, following part_of up and down and uses across. The /hub skill carries the radius on and reports every design it reached. Builds the open dec:idea-a-blast-radius-says-where-it-leaves-its-design-and-a-hub-carries-it-on on the recorded relation.



AS BUILT (2026-10-06):
- Every blast radius (propagate_change, propagate_from; summary and full) names its `design`. A row whose node belongs to another design names that design: a node mirrored from a member (mirror_surface now stamps `mirrored_from` on every mirrored node; a mirrored Project keeps `mirror_of`), or an Interface a `uses` pin names.
- `interfaces_reached` lists every Interface the radius stood on or reached, seeds included.
- `continue_in` names, from this design's pins, the members to carry the radius on in, with seeds. ACROSS into a `uses` peer, seeded at the interfaces and mirrored nodes of it the radius reached. DOWN into a `part_of` part, seeded at what is mirrored from it, or no seeds and a sentence saying why, when only its pin was reached. A pin reached only through the Project is not counted, because every pin hangs off the Project.
- `propagate_from` takes `arriving_from` (another design's id) and `interfaces` instead of seeds. That design's own pins say where the ripple enters: ACROSS each interface its `uses` pin names that the ripple reached; UP from a part at what requires the part (require_resource), or at the pin when nothing does. It replies `arrived: false` and walks nothing when no pin names the design, and its continue_in leaves out the design the ripple came from.
- The /hub skill makes the hop: continue_in, then arriving_from in every member not yet reached, until no new design is reached. It reports every design reached and says where the record has no way through.
LIMITS: an edge still cannot cross a store, so the agent makes each hop, and each hosted design is asked separately. A ripple goes UP only where the parent pins its part. flo2.io serves 0.79.0, so hosted hubs get this when flo2.io moves.
properties.name: A cross-design ripple follows each member's recorded relation and names the design each result belongs to and the one to continue in
